description: Marked G-BVWC. Parked at the former Doncaster Sheffield Airport, where the Vulcan to the Sky Trust runs booked visits. Last confirmed present Apr 2023.

The last flying Avro Vulcan, retired from display flying in October 2015 and now kept in ground-running condition. Airport flying operations ceased in November 2022 but the aircraft remains on site. Parked at the former Doncaster Sheffield Airport, where the Vulcan to the Sky Trust runs booked visits. Last confirmed present Feb 2023.
